facts.fact: Technext reports NIPOST rolled out the National Digital Alphanumeric Postcode System on 1 October 2026, assigning an 11-character GIS-enabled code to addressable buildings, with early users reporting mixed results.

systems.system: Address Verification System / Digital Addressing System

NGA.note: The document only mentions NPC mapping data from the 2022 census as an input to the postcode; it does not state a census count, results or survey.
The document mentions only a 2020 NIPOST-NCC agreement to verify addresses at SIM registration, not a check against the national ID.
